objective.architecture_invariant: retain the Gummel electron/energy <-> Poisson fixed-point architecture
objective.metric: average fixed-point loops per electron step
objective.success_condition: O(10) or lower average FP loops with qualified trajectory/profile parity and long-horizon validation

frozen_invariants: plasma equations and BC ownership at the converged fixed point
thermal charged-heavy wall plus sheath-suppressed electron wall model
physical horizon for each matched control/trial
nonlinear and fixed-point convergence tolerances/stopping criteria

hypotheses.statement: The dominant Gummel contraction defect is the frozen-electron Poisson block; adding a consistent local electron potential sensitivity to the Poisson iteration operator will reduce outer FP work by at least an order of magnitude without changing the converged fixed-point equations.
hypotheses.mechanism: Linearize the local Boltzmann response delta n_e ~= (n_e/T_e[eV]) delta phi. The Poisson subsolve gains a positive Debye-screening reaction term beta*(phi-phi_anchor), beta=e*n_e/(eps0*T_e[eV]); this term vanishes at fixed-point convergence, so it is a Gummel preconditioner rather than a changed converged plasma equation.
hypotheses.falsifier: Reject if the screened trial does not materially reduce FP/step versus same-lane Picard-2x control, becomes unstable, or converges to a trajectory/profile outside qualified parity; O(10) is required for performance promotion, not merely improvement.
prior_evidence: Current Poisson subapp freezes log_e and therefore omits electron potential sensitivity during each Poisson solve.
Picard relaxation saturated near 2/(1+chi_e) with hundreds of FP iterations/step; stronger scalar relaxation produced 2-cycles/runaway.
The current initial transport values give mu_e/D_e close to 1/T_e[eV], supporting the local-response scale as a bounded physics-informed Jacobian surrogate.

discriminating_observables: final electron density, mean energy, potential and charge profiles
screening correction norm approaching zero at fixed-point convergence
controls: same-lane unmodified qualified time-aware Picard-2x control
one heavy cycle / four electron steps / T=400 tau_epsilon(initial) for the first discriminator
identical physics, timestep, tolerances and stopping criteria between control and trial

variants.change: Poisson iteration operator only: beta=e*n_e/(eps0*((2/3)*mean_energy_eV)); correction beta*(phi-phi_anchor) vanishes at the fixed point
